problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Bravo: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Charlie: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment Echo: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Foxtrot: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Golf: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Hotel: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment India: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Juliet: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Kilo: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Lima: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Mike: size 30 cubic meters
* Shipment November: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Oscar: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Papa: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Quebec: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Romeo: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Sierra: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Tango: size 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Uniform: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Victor: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Whiskey: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment X-ray: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment Yankee: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Zulu: size 52 cubic meters
* Shipment Asterisk: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Backslash: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Bracket: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Caret: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Underscore: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Grave: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Alpha2: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Bravo2: size 59 cubic meters
* Shipment Charlie2: size 32 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta2: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Echo2: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Foxtrot2: size 42 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
